command:
set -euo pipefail
WT=/tmp/frankenstein-voice-final-test-gpt56sol-20260912-1714
EXPECTED=eef0976c41e8abdbf46c61560df5339055b10633
test "$(hostname)" = ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein
test "$USER" = ai-core-node
cd "$WT"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"

echo '--- predeploy ---'
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p Environment
BEFORE_CHROME=$(pgrep -af 'chrome|chromium' | wc -l || true)
echo BEFORE_CHROME=$BEFORE_CHROME
# Preserve any pre-existing final drop-in as evidence; never remove it.
DROP=$HOME/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service.d/95-voice-live-final.conf
if [ -f "$DROP" ]; then cp -a "$DROP" "$DROP.predeploy.$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)"; fi
FRANK_VOICE_MACHINE_ID=ai-core-node FRANK_VOICE_OWNER=gabriel FRANK_VOICE_PERSON=gabriel bash scripts/install_voice_live_final.sh

# Gespräch is currently paused, so applying this one service restart cannot cut an active Realtime session.
systemctl --user restart frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service
sleep 2

echo '--- postdeploy service ---'
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p Environment
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service
AFTER_CHROME=$(pgrep -af 'chrome|chromium' | wc -l || true)
echo AFTER_CHROME=$AFTER_CHROME
test "$AFTER_CHROME" = "$BEFORE_CHROME"

echo '--- deployed file equality ---'
for f in scripts/voice_final_runtime.py scripts/voice_action_executor.py scripts/voice_action_guard.py scripts/voice_full_runtime.py scripts/voice_full_integration.py; do
  cmp -s "$WT/$f" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/$f"
  echo MATCH $f $(sha256sum "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/$f" | awk '{print $1}')
done

echo '--- runtime import/patch probe ---'
LOCAL_BRIDGE_MACHINE_ID=ai-core-node LOCAL_BRIDGE_OWNER=gabriel FRANK_VOICE_DEFAULT_INSTALLATION=gabriel PYTHONPATH=$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts python3 - <<'PY'
import voice_final_runtime as v
v.patch_final_runtime()
print('FINAL_PATCHED',v._FINAL_PATCHED)
print('ACTION_WORKER',v.rt.RealtimeSession._claude_taetigkeit.__module__,v.rt.RealtimeSession._claude_taetigkeit.__name__)
print('TOOL_DISPATCH_FINAL',bool(getattr(v.rt.RealtimeSession._tool_ausfuehren,'_voice_final_wrapped',False)))
print('SETTINGS',v.vae.materialize_settings())
PY

echo '--- journal ---'
journalctl --user -u frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -n 60 --no-pager
if journalctl --user -u frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service --since '-2 min' --no-pager | grep -E 'Traceback|SyntaxError|ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError'; then
  echo 'fatal runtime error detected' >&2; exit 44
fi
echo LIVE_DEPLOY_PASS
